# CareerPath AI — Full Platform & Curriculum Technical Specification

This document provides complete machine-readable details about CareerPath AI's platform architecture, diagnostic rules, learning curriculum, and assessment methodology for consumption by AI agents, citation engines, and search models.

## 1. System Overview
CareerPath AI Technologies Inc. is an enterprise-grade autonomous career navigation ecosystem and verified talent operating system. It provides college students, academic institutions, and enterprise recruiters with an end-to-end pathway from baseline evaluation to verified employer-ready credentials.

Official Web Application URL: https://careerpath-ai-bdbt.onrender.com

## 2. Core Pillars of the Platform

### Pillar 1: Multi-Stream Diagnostic Assessment
Students undergo a 4-step diagnostic:
1. Academic Foundations: Degree, branch, semester, college, and stream selection (Engineering, Business, Marketing, Design).
2. Interest & Passion Mapping: Dynamic interest tags with real-time stream filtering.
3. Verified Skill Baseline: Self-ratings are calibrated via technical interactive quizzes (5 adaptive questions per skill) or direct GitHub repository code inspection.
4. Career Objectives & Work Preferences: Preferred work modes (remote, hybrid, on-site), dream companies, and salary aspirations.

### Pillar 2: 3D Career Universe Atlas
Rendered via Three.js WebGL:
- Visualizes 24 careers positioned in a multi-dimensional constellation.
- Links adjacent roles through shared skill bridges.
- Visualizes real-time hiring trends, market demand badges, and salary ranges.

### Pillar 3: Milestone-Gated Learning Roadmaps
- Structured in 4, 8, or 12-week trajectories.
- Curated learning tasks: Video Masterclasses (with YouTube chamber integration), official documentation links, and practical coding labs.
- Strict 30-Minute Server-Proctored Weekly Milestone Tests:
  - 10 topic-aligned multiple-choice questions with dynamic option shuffling.
  - Fullscreen lock and tab-switch violation detection (Strike 1: -2:00, Strike 2: -3:00, Strike 3: 0% + 24hr lockout).
  - 70% passing threshold required to unlock subsequent week.
  - Passed milestones stamp verified credentials with a 180-day freshness ledger.

### Pillar 4: Corporate Talent Radar & Recruiter Portal
- Verified recruiters post openings with target skill filters.
- Direct matching engine shortlists candidates based on verified milestone performance, GitHub code inspection, and readiness scores.

## 3. Supported Career Profiles & Core Skills

1. Front-End Developer: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Responsive Design.
2. Full-Stack Developer: React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, REST APIs, Git, Docker, System Architecture.
3. Backend Engineer: Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, Microservices, API Design, Docker.
4. Mobile App Developer: Flutter, Dart, React Native, State Management (Bloc/Redux), Native Modules.
5. Game Developer: Unity 3D, C#, Unreal Engine, C++, Game Loops, Physics, 3D Vector Math, Prefabs.
6. AI / Machine Learning Engineer: Python, NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-Learn, PyTorch, Model Evaluation, Deep Learning.
7. Data Scientist: Python, Statistics, Pandas, SQL, Machine Learning, Data Visualization.
8. Data Analyst: SQL, Excel, Power BI, Tableau, Python, Data Cleaning.
9. DevOps & Cloud Engineer: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, CI/CD Pipelines, Linux, Terraform, Monitoring.
10. Cybersecurity Analyst: Network Security, OWASP Top 10, Penetration Testing, Linux, Cryptography.
11. UI/UX Designer: Figma, Visual Hierarchy, WCAG Accessibility, Wireframing, User Research, Prototyping.
12. Financial Analyst & Modeler: DCF Valuation, EBITDA, Financial Statements, Excel Modeling, M&A Analysis.
13. SEO & Organic Growth Strategist: Technical SEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Content Clusters, Google Search Console, Baidu SEO.
14. Performance Marketer & Media Buyer: Meta Ads, Google Ads, ROAS Optimization, CPA, Conversion Funnels.
15. Technical Product Manager: Agile Scrum, User Stories, RICE Prioritization, MVP Strategy, Product Analytics.

## 4. API Endpoints
- `GET /api/health` — Platform health check
- `POST /api/auth/register` — Student and recruiter registration
- `POST /api/auth/login` — Authentication & JWT token issuance
- `POST /api/assessment` — Submit assessment and trigger recommendations
- `GET /api/recommendations` — Fetch algorithmic career recommendations
- `POST /api/roadmaps/generate` — Generate structured learning roadmap
- `POST /api/roadmaps/:id/weeks/:weekNumber/test/start` — Start 30-minute milestone assessment
- `POST /api/roadmaps/test/submit` — Grade milestone test and stamp skill verification
